translation: Took place in posad Serock, 9 May 1890, 9 AM. Appeared personally Jankiel Borensztejn, carpenter[?], 36[?], and Josek Kuligowski, trader, 33, residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 8 AM in the village of Zegrze died a child of female sex named Ruchla Jagoda, daughter of Dawid and Itta nee Kuligowska, the Jagoda spouses, aged two months. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
